summary: Panel hero after ELEKS: a large rounded photo panel with the headline, lead and buttons over a dark shade, then 3-4 tall narrow photo panels side by side, each labelled vertically with one of the client's real service lines or industries and linking to its section. Hovering or focusing a narrow panel widens it and shows one line about it. An optional small white card across the joint offers a consultation. On tablets and phones the narrow panels become rows under the main panel. Needs one wide photo and one photo per panel; suits software, IT and IT-BPO companies with a few clear sectors or service lines.
